entities.summary: Uzbekistan is a sovereign nation in Central Asia, Asia. Its capital is Tashkent. Official languages include Uzbek. Government: Unitary presidential republic. Population: approximately 36.2 million. Area: 448,978 km². Comprehensive index for Uzbekistan covering Sogdian merchants, Achaemenid Transoxiana, Alexander/Hellenistic Bactria, Kushan Empire, Turkic khaganates, Samanid dynasty (Bukhara/Samarkand, Islamic Golden Age), Mongol conquest, Timurid Empire (Tamerlane 1370-1405, Samarkand capital), Shaybanid/Bukhara Khanate, Kokand Khanate, Russian conquest 1865-1876, Soviet Uzbek SSR (cotton/'White Gold', Aral Sea disaster), independence 1991, Karimov's authoritarian rule, Andijan massacre 2005, and Mirziyoyev's reforms.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Uzbekistan's strategic location and rich cultural heritage have made it a crossroads of trade and conquest throughout history. The country's transformation from a Soviet republic to an independent nation has had significant regional implications for Central Asia.
